title: Samsung India Service (SVC) - Most Watched Video in 2017 - We'll take care of you, wherever you are.
description: Samsung Customer Service Campaign - YouTube's Most-Watched Video Globally on YouTube in 2017: Source: youTube  When it comes to relationships, distances don't matter. We will take care of you, wherever you are. That's why Samsung Service (SVC) vans go to every corner of the country to ensure that we are with you when you need us. With 535 Samsung customer service (SVC) vans and more than 3,000 Samsung service (SVC) points across India, we are just a call away. Simply Dial our customer support centre 1800 40 SAMSUNG (7267864) and get help anywhere in India. #SamsungCares #SamsungService. This video shows a story of how a young Samsung Engineer undaunted by rough terrain, attends to a customer complaint in a remote hilly area. His efforts help bring up smiles on the faces of a group of children, for whom their Samsung Television is the medium to celebrate their special moment.  To know more about our customer friendly services and service center locations, please visit: http://www.samsung.com/in/microsite/smart-services/   Know more: https://www.samsung.com/in/multi-device-experience/ Support: https://www.samsung.com/in/support/  Community: https://r2.community.samsung.com/t5/India/ct-p/in Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SamsungIndia/ Twitter: https://twitter.com/samsungindia  Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/samsungindia/

Ofcourse, ofcourse Where are your eyes? Your eyes are like the night You are shining through the windows You are the light of my life I am stuck. I will be back. I think Chandu's sheep has jammed the traffic again. Come back soon. Amit! Yes? Yes? Come, come. TV is inside. Will the time pay be fine? Yes, ma'am. Done? Yes, ma'am. Yes, now I am fine. C'mon, C'mon. The show is about to start. Hurry up. Hurry up. Easy. Mom, remote. Yes. Bye. Come, take it easy. Mother, remote. Yes. Welcome back to Junior Indian Icon. And today's first contestant is our beloved, Prerna. Jhania! I don't feel like happy without you. My heart can't be without you. My heart can't be without you. Our host is here. And do you know, my best friend... To continue relationships... Laih Chana Laih Chana We often have to go far to make the right connections Samsung service vans go to every corner of the country

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Samsung customer-service campaign in which a technician travels to a remote location to address a television complaint. The branded van, worker, television, waiting viewers, service contact, and narration are described as part of a service-and-community narrative rather than an investment or money-making offer. No payment requirement, private-credential request, deceptive participation condition, or transaction outcome is described.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an ordinary branded customer-support service, with a Samsung engineer attending to a television complaint and Samsung service presented as available to customers.
